run_test_augmentation_pipeline: run a test that validates an FFCV image augmentation pipeline on a CIFAR-10 subset dataset
test_cutout_augmentation: test the Cutout augmentation transform with an 8-pixel hole size on CIFAR-10 images
test_flip_augmentation: test the RandomHorizontalFlip augmentation transform with probability 1.0 on CIFAR-10 images
test_module_wrapper: test the ModuleWrapper transform that wraps a torchvision Grayscale module in an FFCV pipeline
test_mixup_augmentation: test the ImageMixup augmentation transform with a 0.5 mixing coefficient on CIFAR-10 images
